body.label: Target
body.html: Self; choose a visible line of 4 spaces within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, your ranged attacks against creatures in the line ignore 1 point of cover bonus. You gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks from the line.

surges.html: Bend the line once around a corner you can see.
An ally within 3 units gains the same attack benefit until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: Establish Lock on one visible creature in the line. If it leaves the line before your next turn, you may transfer Lock to another visible creature inside it.
